trials.notes: Single 370-line taskman.misa produces both artifacts. Deliverable passed misa check, misa build, and verify_taskman.sh 27/27 on the first attempt each; APK built first try and verify_apk.sh 6/6. The one logged loop was a scratch language probe (brace-escape rule), not a deliverable defect. CLI: env-var dispatch with TASKMAN_CMD unset -> navigate(Home()) for Android; all error paths print 'Error: ...' then throw an Error record so the AOT binary exits 1 with a clean one-line report (no traceback). Import validates array-ness via json.stringify '[' prefix because for-in iterates Text as chars. APK: app block + Home screen (Heading, Text, List driven by task_lines() over the same SQLite schema/table decl, TextInput + Button inserting via the same db.exec path); on-device runtime unverified (no emulator/device on this box), per the honesty note.
